name: claude-code-devkit
description: A spec-driven-development toolkit for Claude Code: eight skills that take a feature from one task description through GitHub Spec Kit's eight phases to a reviewed pull or merge request, drive its bug-triage workflow from one bug report to a verified fix, carry a failed CI pipeline to a validated fix, and handle the git and forge work in between, plus a seven-check quality gate that runs on POSIX sh and digest-pinned containers.
